semantics.alias_rule: fresh canonical native RGB8 image boundary value with no retained tensor storage alias
semantics.shape_rule: CHW input with exactly three channels maps to a height by width interleaved RGB8 image
semantics.dtype_rule: CPU F32 values use torchvision 0.27 byte scaling semantics and CPU U8 values are copied byte-exactly
semantics.accumulation_dtype: F32 scaling before U8 conversion for floating input; not applicable for U8 input
semantics.layout_rule: logical CHW tensor reads map deterministically to interleaved HWC RGB8 bytes
semantics.device_rule: CPU ordinal zero on the input stream; other native devices fail typed
semantics.numeric_rule: torchvision 0.27 ToPILImage RGB conversion represented by Zed canonical Rgb8ImageTensor without Python or PIL runtime ownership
semantics.determinism: fixed row, column, and channel traversal
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation, during bounded image conversion, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: forward-only non-differentiable media boundary at the cataloged drawing-node inference call site
semantics.jvp_rule: forward-only non-differentiable media boundary at the cataloged drawing-node inference call site
